NICS0010.ol:
# 30th Nov 2020: BPE ASIC Temperature OOL Validity Parameter - NICS0010
# Synthetic parameter to determine if BPE ASIC Temperature is valid
#
# ----------------------
#
# BPE_ASIC_Temp_RTHK
#
# Only valid if SPICE is in Standby, Engineering or Operate mode, i.e. Mode(NIC0FR00) <= 2
if (NIC0FR00.raw <= 2) then
   return (1);
else
   return (0);
endif;

NXAS161R.ol:
###########################################################
# This synthetic calculates the consistency of the
# instantiated service 12 packet for SMON 161 of PID 11
#
# In case the order in which the monitors are reported
# in the generic service 12 packet, this synthetic
# will flag the incorrectly parsed monitors as invalid.
#
# Returns 1 if the parsed and intended monitoring IDs match
#         0 otherwise
#
###########################################################

if (NXAS161A.raw == 161) then
   return (1);
else
   return (0);
endif;
